children: On November 24, 2026, iQSTEL received notice from Nasdaq that its stock had closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, failing Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The stock continues trading on Nasdaq, and the company has until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance by meeting the $1.00 threshold for at least 10 consecutive business days; a second 180-day period may be available if it meets other requirements.
